system.description:
Users of the Aspect of Brutality are able to unleash a powerful attack by focusing the power of their Soul Armament for one Round.

Impending Doom causes your first Focused Attack during the next Round to gain the following benefits:

  • becomes a Swift Action
  • base damage equal to 2 x Soul
  • gain 1 additional Ichor if the attack lands

For the remainder of the Round that Impending Doom is used in, its user suffers -1 to their Dodge and Evasion as they focus on empowering their next strike.
